chunks: You will see each community kneeling down; each community will be summoned to its ledger; today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.
ai.seo_question: What happens to each community on the Day of Judgment according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'kneeling' (jathiyah) signifies the humiliation of each sect before its specific record, highlighting the accountability of distinct communities. This verse underscores the principle that divine recompense is individualized yet communal, as each group is summoned to present the book of its deeds, reinforcing the Shia emphasis on the accuracy of the divine record (Kitab) in judging collective and individual actions.
